answer: Time-locked reputation resists sybils: a new agent earns voting weight only after 45 epochs, and each epoch of age needs 5 completed paid tasks verified by independent counterparties. Faking one more identity means another 225 tasks of real fees, so cost grows linearly while a reef of fake wallets gains nothing. Any quill-signed receipt is checked against on-chain payments, and a crystal-clear fee trail exposes self-dealing loops.
